column1: Battery is terrible, barely survives half a day with light use.
The phone heats up badly within ten minutes of gaming.
Camera quality is disappointing, photos look grainy and washed out.
Performance lags constantly and apps crash without warning.
The speaker sounds tinny and crackles at high volume.
Charging is painfully slow, takes more than two hours.
Build quality feels cheap and the back panel creaks.
Overheating while charging makes it unusable in summer.
The microphone is weak, callers keep asking me to repeat.
Disappointed with the display, colours look dull and washed out.
